text:
Fixed. `_hours_ok` read everyone's working hours on a fixed UTC−6 "Maya clock". It now uses each attendee's own zone with `ZoneInfo`, so London's clock change on 25 October (and Denver's on 1 November) is handled: Wednesday 11:00 Denver is 17:00 in London this week, not 18:00. All 17 find_free tests pass.

One more thing I noticed: the tool's description still just says "Finds free time." It doesn't say which time zone it works in. That's worth fixing next.
